metadata.question: Was there snow present in the Atacama Desert during the months of June and July in 2025?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Location: Atacama Desert (northern Chile, approximately -24°S, -69°W) - Time: June and July 2025 - Collection: Sentinel-2 for snow detection (higher resolution), fallback to Landsat 8/9 if needed - Snow index: NDSI (Normalized Difference Snow Index) = (Green - SWIR) / (Green + SWIR) 2. Masking strategy: - Need to mask clouds to avoid false positives - Use cloud probability mask for Sentinel-2 - NDSI > 0.4 typically indicates snow presence 3. Logic for distinguishing results: - Valid Zero (B): Images found, pixels processed, but NDSI values don't indicate snow - Yes (A): Clear snow pixels detected (NDSI > 0.4) - C1: No images in the collection for the time period - C2: Images exist but all pixels masked out - C3: Calculation returns None/NaN ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define Atacama Desert region const atacama = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([-70.5, -25.5, -68.0, -22.5]); // 2. Define time period const startDate = '2025-06-01'; const endDate = '2025-07-31'; // 3. Load Sentinel-2 data let collection = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(atacama) .filterDate(startDate, endDate); const collectionSize = collection.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Sentinel-2 images found: ${collectionSize}`); // 4. If no Sentinel-2, try Landsat 9 if (collectionSize === 0) { console.log('Trying Landsat 9...'); collection = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC09/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(atacama) .filterDate(startDate, endDate); const l9Size = collection.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Landsat 9 images found: ${l9Size}`); if (l9Size === 0) { console.log('No images available for June-July 2025.'); console.log('C1'); return; } } // 5. Process collection for snow detection function addNDSI(image) { let ndsi; if (image.bandNames().contains('B3').getInfo()) { // Sentinel-2: Green=B3, SWIR=B11 ndsi = image.normalizedDifference(['B3', 'B11']).rename('NDSI'); } else { // Landsat: Green=SR_B3, SWIR=SR_B6 ndsi = image.normalizedDifference(['SR_B3', 'SR_B6']).rename('NDSI'); } return image.addBands(ndsi); } function maskClouds(image) { if (image.bandNames().contains('QA60').getInfo()) { // Sentinel-2 cloud masking const qa = image.select('QA60'); const cloudMask = qa.bitwiseAnd(1024).eq(0).and(qa.bitwiseAnd(2048).eq(0)); return image.updateMask(cloudMask); } else { // Landsat cloud masking const qa = image.select('QA_PIXEL'); const cloudMask = qa.bitwiseAnd(8).eq(0).and(qa.bitwiseAnd(16).eq(0)); return image.updateMask(cloudMask); } } const processedCollection = collection.map(maskClouds).map(addNDSI); // 6. Create composite and check for snow const ndsiComposite = processedCollection.select('NDSI').max(); // 7. Count valid pixels const pixelCount = ndsiComposite.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: atacama, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDSI').getInfo(); console.log(`Valid pixels after cloud masking: ${pixelCount}`); if (pixelCount === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels after cloud masking.'); console.log('C2'); return; } // 8. Calculate snow statistics const snowThreshold = 0.4; const snowMask = ndsiComposite.gt(snowThreshold); const snowPixels = snowMask.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: atacama, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDSI').getInfo(); const maxNDSI = ndsiComposite.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.max(), geometry: atacama, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDSI').getInfo(); console.log(`Max NDSI value: ${maxNDSI !== null ? maxNDSI.toFixed(3) : 'null'}`); console.log(`Snow pixels (NDSI > 0.4): ${snowPixels !== null ? Math.round(snowPixels) : 'null'}`); // 9. Validate and determine answer if (maxNDSI === null || snowPixels === null) { console.log('Calculation failed to return valid values.'); console.log('C3'); return; } if (snowPixels > 0) { console.log('Snow detected in Atacama Desert during June-July 2025.'); console.log('A'); } else { console.log('No snow detected in Atacama Desert during June-July 2025.'); console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
